abilities.notes: Melee attackers must succeed a DC 12 Endurance check or have their weapon begin to rust, suffering -1 damage until repaired.

lore: The Salt-Withered are born from sailors who died betrayed or unshriven at sea. Coastal communities leave iron nails and bread along shorelines to ward off their return. A gaunt figure draped in rotting naval garb, hair strung with seaweed and shells, skin cracked like dry coral. Salt encrusts its joints, and barnacles form armor along its arms and spine.

name: Sand Golem
environment: Desert ruins, buried temples, arid vaults

attacks.name: Slam (x2)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: two Slam attacks. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Sandstorm Blast (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: Nimbleness save (DC 18) or take full damage, half on success. Area = difficult terrain until end of golem's next turn. Largest damage roll in the golem family.

attacks.name: Burial Surge (Action)
attacks.notes: Area becomes quicksand. Strength save (DC 18) or Restrained as they sink. Action to attempt another Strength check to escape. Lasts until start of golem's next turn.

abilities.name: Flowing Form (Passive)
abilities.notes: Can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch. Can disperse into a sand cloud, gaining resistance to all damage except Force, Psychic, and Radiant until start of next turn.

abilities.name: Sand Cloak (Passive)
abilities.notes: While burrowed in sand or loose earth, can Hide as a bonus action. Tremorsense 60 ft — detects all movement on the ground even when buried.

lore: The Sand Golem strikes from below — burrowing under the battlefield while Tremorsense tracks every footstep, then erupting with a Sandstorm Blast (the highest single damage roll of any golem at 10d10) or Burial Surge to sink the party in quicksand. Flowing Form makes it nearly impossible to pin in place.

name: Sea-Bright Wyrmling
environment: Coastal cliffs, tide caves, storm-wracked beaches

attacks.name: Crackling Bite
attacks.notes: Target must succeed Endurance save (DC 13) or be shocked, losing 5 ft of movement next turn. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Flash Arc (1/rest)
attacks.notes: All targets must make a Nimbleness save (DC 14) or be Stunned for 1 round.

abilities.name: Glimmerhide (Passive)
abilities.notes: Attacks made in dim light or darkness are at Disadvantage unless the attacker succeeds Perception (DC 13) due to scale glare.

abilities.name: Stormbound Leap (Recharge 4-6)
abilities.notes: May leap up to 20 ft and immediately make a Crackling Bite attack at no movement cost.

lore: Believed to be born when lightning strikes tidepools during storms. Fisherfolk consider them omens — blessing or curse depending on whether they're seen at sea or on land. Sleek and serpent-like, with glistening scales that pulse between seafoam blue and stormsilver. A dorsal fin runs from crown to tail, glowing faintly in darkness. When agitated, sparks dance across its limbs and mouth.

name: Sea-Glass Harvester
environment: Ship graveyards, tide-swept ruins, sunken harbors

attacks.name: Glassbone Lash
attacks.notes: On hit, target must succeed Endurance save (DC 14) or suffer -1 DR for 1 minute (shards cling and vibrate painfully). Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Shardstorm (Recharge 5-6)
attacks.notes: Targets must succeed Nimbleness save (DC 15) or become Bleeding (1d4 damage at start of each turn for 2 rounds).

abilities.name: Whispers of the Deep (Passive, 10 ft)
abilities.notes: Enemies within 10 ft hear faint voices from the jars. Must make Wisdom save (DC 13) or suffer Disadvantage on their next attack or spell.

abilities.name: Memory Jar (1/rest)
abilities.notes: Target must make Luck save (DC 14) or lose access to one known skill or spell for 1 round — it is 'stolen' and whispered into one of the Harvester's jars.

lore: Some believe it was once a mortal who lost their crew to a sea curse. Others say it forms where too many souls lie unburied. It cannot cross running water, but it can follow voices through dreams. A robed, stooped figure with limbs too long and a face of smooth glass. Sea-glass shards flicker like stars across its garments, and jars full of bones and trinkets clink with every step.

name: Shadow Golem
environment: Dark vaults, shadowfell-touched ruins, necromancer lairs

attacks.name: Shadowy Grasp (x2)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: two Slam or Shadowy Grasp attacks. Grasp: target's speed -10 ft until start of golem's next turn; golem gains temp HP = half necrotic dealt. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Shadow Breath (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: Endurance save (DC 17) or take full damage and be Blinded until end of next turn. Half on success. Largest cone in the golem family (30 ft).

abilities.name: Shadow Stealth & Gloom Veil
abilities.notes: In dim light or darkness: can Hide as bonus action, and ranged attacks against it have disadvantage. Life Drain: regains temp HP = half necrotic dealt.

abilities.name: Phantom Step (Rech 5-6, Reaction)
abilities.notes: When it takes damage, can teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness. No opportunity attacks. Only effective in darkness — bright light shuts down most of its kit.

lore: Unlike any other golem, the Shadow Golem rewards the darkness. It hides, heals from necrotic damage, evades ranged attacks, and teleports when struck — but only in dim light or darkness. A Light spell or Daylight neutralizes most of its advantages, making light sources tactically critical in this fight.

name: Shadow Specter
environment: Dark dungeons, shadow-cursed ruins, moonless nights

attacks.name: Life Drain
attacks.notes: Endurance save (DC 13) or HP maximum reduced by damage taken until long rest. Dies if max HP reaches 0. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Shadow Bolt (60 ft)
attacks.notes: Ranged spell attack.

abilities.name: Possess Shadow (Action)
abilities.notes: Targets one creature within 30 ft. Charisma save (DC 15) or possessed for 1 hour: 2d6 Necrotic per turn. Ends with Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or bright light exposure.

abilities.name: Shadowy Form & Legendary
abilities.notes: Advantage on Stealth and invisible to darkvision in dim light/darkness. Weakness: bright light deals 3d6 radiant per turn. Legendary (1/round): Shadow Step (30 ft, dim light only) or Life Drain (costs 2).

lore: The Shadow Specter haunts the spaces between light and dark, possessing its prey's own shadow to feed on their soul. The HP maximum reduction from Life Drain is potentially lethal over time — a party that doesn't rest will find their members dropping dead even without taking further damage.

name: Shield Spider
environment: Caves, underground nests, ruins, mine shafts

attacks.name: Bite (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: one Bite + one Web. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Web (Rech 5-6, 30/60 ft)
attacks.notes: Target is Restrained by webbing. DC 14 Strength check to escape. Web: AC 10, 10 HP, vulnerable to fire.

abilities.name: Underground Ambusher (Passive)
abilities.notes: Has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have not yet acted in combat when ambushing from its nest.

abilities.name: Stealthy Retreat (Legendary, 1/round)
abilities.notes: At end of another creature's turn, moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can attempt to Hide (Stealth +10). Spider Climb: can climb any surface including ceilings.

lore: Protected by a boney carapace that deflects blows, the Shield Spider ambushes from underground nests and retreats into shadow after striking. Its hit-and-run tactics and legendary stealth make it a persistent threat that's hard to pin down — it strikes, webs its prey, then vanishes into the dark to strike again.

name: Skull Spider
environment: Crypts, necromancer lairs, cursed ruins, bone pits

attacks.name: Bite (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: one Bite + one Web. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Web (Rech 5-6, 30/60 ft)
attacks.notes: Target is Restrained. DC 15 Strength to escape. Web: AC 10, 10 HP, vulnerable to fire.

attacks.name: Deathly Stealth (Passive)
attacks.notes: Advantage on Stealth checks in dark or dim light. Undead Nature: does not require air, food, drink, or sleep. Spider Climb: can climb any surface including ceilings.

attacks.name: Shadow Step (Legendary, 1/round)
attacks.notes: At end of another creature's turn, magically teleports up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness.

lore: An undead arachnid with a skull-like carapace, the Skull Spider haunts crypts and bone pits. It needs no sustenance — only prey. Its necrotic bite drains life force, and its ability to Shadow Step through darkness makes it a relentless pursuer that appears and vanishes like a nightmare.

name: Skyrend Maw
environment: Clifftops, battlefield sites, cursed skies

attacks.name: Rending Bite
attacks.notes: If the target has taken damage this round, add +1d4 Psychic as it feeds on fear. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Shattering Howl (1/rest)
attacks.notes: All creatures in cone take 2d4 Thunder damage. Failed Endurance save (DC 14) = Deafened for 1 round. Unsecured items are scattered; fires, torches, and magic lights flicker or extinguish.

abilities.name: Blood-Seeker Instinct (Passive)
abilities.notes: Immediately knows the direction of any creature currently below half HP within 60 ft.

abilities.name: Hover of Dread (Aura, 10 ft)
abilities.notes: While flying, all creatures within 10 ft suffer -1 to attack damage rolls unless they succeed on an Insight check (DC 13) each round.

abilities.name: Evasive Flutter (Reaction, 2/enc)
abilities.notes: When hit by a melee attack, may move 10 ft without provoking a reaction.

lore: The Skyrend Maw is said to be the soul of a slain oathbreaker or murderer whose final rage echoed into the storm. In some traditions, its approach is a divine warning to end conflict — or be consumed by it. Children raised near clifftop settlements are warned: 'Don't scream at the wind, or it'll scream back.' A grotesque, severed head the size of a wolf, trailing smoky tendrils, its mouth stretches unnaturally wide and a faint storm swirls in its wake.

name: Sloughclot
environment: Marsh pits, sunken graveyards, drowned battlefields

attacks.name: Digesting Slam
attacks.notes: Target must succeed Endurance save (DC 15) or begin Melting (1d4 acid damage per round for 2 rounds). Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Corpse Echo (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: Mimics a dead loved one's voice. Creatures must make Wisdom save (DC 15) or be Charmed for 1 round. Fail by 5+: Paralyzed instead.

attacks.name: Pseudopod Lurch (10 ft)
attacks.notes: Target must succeed Nimbleness save (DC 14) or be Pulled prone into an adjacent square.

abilities.name: Corpse Memory (Passive)
abilities.notes: Carries memories of its victims. Once per combat, gains advantage on any check against a creature it has already damaged this combat.

abilities.name: Rot Pulse (At Half HP)
abilities.notes: Emits a wave of necrotic bile. All creatures within 10 ft take 1d6 Necrotic damage and must succeed Wisdom save (DC 14) or gain the Sickened condition.

lore: Swampkeepers claim every Sloughclot is made from thirty or more corpses. Some say they can remember every death they've consumed — and they scream them in the dark. A dripping mass of dark red sludge and putrid yellow bile, filled with fragments of faces and skulls that briefly surface before being digested again.

name: Small Rock Crab
environment: Rocky coastlines, sea caves, tidal pools, ruins

attacks.name: Claw (x2)
attacks.notes: Two claws, each can grapple one Small or smaller target (escape DC 10). Sneak Attack: +1d6 damage when it has advantage. Melee 5 ft.

abilities.name: Perfect Camouflage (Passive)
abilities.notes: When motionless, indistinguishable from a boulder. Advantage on Stealth in rocky terrain. DC 13 Perception to detect.

abilities.name: Boulder Form (Action)
abilities.notes: Retracts into shell — AC increases to 16, cannot move or act. Can exit as bonus action. Amphibious: breathes air and water.

lore: A small crustacean with a mottled shell that blends seamlessly into rocky terrain. Its eyes sit on stalks, watching from cover while it waits for unsuspecting prey. The Boulder Form ability makes it nearly impervious when defensive — but it can't act while tucked in. A surprising low-level ambush encounter when a whole tide pool of 'boulders' suddenly awakens.

name: Soul-Bound Lich
environment: Hidden towers, cursed villages, planar nexus points

attacks.name: Paralyzing Touch
attacks.notes: Endurance save (DC 18) or Paralyzed for 1 minute (save ends each turn). Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Power Word Kill (1/rest)
attacks.notes: Kills one creature with 100 HP or fewer — no save. Also has: Disintegrate, Finger of Death, Circle of Death, Dominate Person, Cloudkill. Spell save DC 18.

attacks.name: Soul Drain (Legendary, 2 actions)
attacks.notes: Endurance save (DC 18) or take full damage; lich regains HP equal to damage dealt. Half on success, no HP regain.

abilities.name: Legendary Actions (3/round)
abilities.notes: Cantrip (1), Frightening Gaze (1 — DC 18 WIS or Frightened), Disrupt Life (2 — 20 ft, 6d6 necrotic), Soul Drain (2), Soul Binding (3 — bind soul of creature at 0 HP, preventing resurrection until lich is destroyed).

abilities.name: Rejuvenation & Soul Bound
abilities.notes: Regains all HP in 1d10 days unless Remove Curse/Greater Restoration/Wish is cast on remains. Soul Bound: can bind soul to a child's body — child makes DC 18 Endurance save or is possessed by the lich.

lore: The Soul-Bound Lich disguises itself as a kind elder traveler, slipping into villages to bind its soul to an innocent child — a horrifying escape plan that makes destroying it a moral nightmare. Soul Binding can prevent resurrection of fallen party members until the lich is permanently destroyed. Power Word Kill with no save makes every encounter potentially lethal.

name: Spectral Knight
environment: Haunted keeps, cursed battlefields, ancient crypts

attacks.name: Ethereal Sword (x2)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: two strikes. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Haunting Presence (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: Wisdom save (DC 15) or be Frightened for 1 minute (save ends each turn).

attacks.name: Incorporeal Movement (Passive)
attacks.notes: Can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. Takes 1d10 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

attacks.name: Legendary Actions (1/round)
attacks.notes: Spectral Step (teleport 30 ft to a visible unoccupied space) or Necrotic Slash (one Ethereal Sword attack).

lore: A fallen warrior bound to undeath by oath and sorrow, the Spectral Knight phases through walls and allies alike, striking with a blade of pure force. Its Haunting Presence scatters armies, and its legendary Spectral Step lets it appear anywhere on the battlefield to finish the weakened.

name: Spectral Sorcerer
environment: Haunted towers, cursed libraries, ancient battlefields

attacks.name: Spectral Touch (x2)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: two Spectral Touch attacks. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Necrotic Bolt (60 ft)
attacks.notes: Ranged spell attack.

attacks.name: Circle of Death (1/rest)
attacks.notes: Endurance save (DC 16) or take full damage, half on success. Also has: Dominate Person, Phantasmal Killer, Fear, Cloudkill, Greater Invisibility.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement (Passive)
abilities.notes: Moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. Takes 1d10 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

abilities.name: Legendary Actions (1/round)
abilities.notes: Ethereal Step (teleport 30 ft to a visible unoccupied space) or Casting Spell (costs 2 — cast one prepared spell). Spell save DC 16. Also has: Magic Missile, Mirror Image, Counterspell, Misty Step.

lore: A master of arcane magic bound to undeath, the Spectral Sorcerer hovers above the battlefield, raining necrotic destruction while phasing through walls and counterspelling the party's magic. Circle of Death can wipe an entire room, and Dominate Person turns a party member against their allies.

name: Stone Golem
environment: Wizard towers, ancient temples, sealed vaults

attacks.name: Slam (x2)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: two Slam attacks. Attacks count as magical. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Slow (Rech 5-6, 10 ft)
attacks.notes: Targets within 10 ft make Wisdom save (DC 17) or be Slowed for 1 min: no reactions, half speed, one attack or action per turn (not both). Save ends each turn.

abilities.name: Immutable Form (Passive)
abilities.notes: Immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form. Magic Resistance: advantage on saves against spells and magical effects.

lore: A massive animated statue of dense stone, built to guard and obey. It cannot be charmed, frightened, petrified, or altered by magic, and its Slow ability can cripple an entire party's action economy in one move. Immune to nonmagical weapons — only magical attacks or spells (which it resists) can harm it.

name: Storm-Cried Child
environment: Shipwreck coasts, abandoned lighthouses, drowned villages

attacks.name: Wail of the Lost (1/rest)
attacks.notes: All creatures must make Wisdom save (DC 15) or be Stunned for 1 round and take double damage.

attacks.name: Cold Touch
attacks.notes: Target's DR is reduced by 1 until end of its next turn (minimum 0). Melee 5 ft.

abilities.name: Haunting Presence (Passive, 10 ft)
abilities.notes: Creatures that begin their turn within 10 ft must succeed a Luck save (DC 13) or suffer disadvantage on all attack rolls that turn due to overwhelming sorrow.

abilities.name: Cry for Recognition (Recharge 4-6)
abilities.notes: Targets within 60 ft hear their own name whispered on the wind. Must succeed Insight save (DC 14) or move 10 ft toward the Storm-Cried Child uncontrollably.

lore: Said to be souls of children lost at sea whose names were never spoken in prayer. Only by speaking their name at a shrine or bell can they be released. The spectral figure of a young child, hair matted with saltwater, face blurred and translucent. Pale-blue light leaks from its eyes and mouth during its mournful cry.

name: Thornback Leechwolf
environment: Wetland dens, willow groves, parasite-ridden bog tunnels

attacks.name: Spine Pounce (Leap 20 ft)
attacks.notes: Target must make Endurance save (DC 14) or be Numbed (disadvantage on physical actions for 1 round). Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Drainbite
attacks.notes: Target loses 1 DR for 1 round as blood flow weakens (minimum 0).

attacks.name: Barbed Shake (1/rest)
attacks.notes: All creatures within 5 ft must succeed Nimbleness save (DC 13) or be Slowed for 1 round.

abilities.name: Pack Instincts (Passive)
abilities.notes: If within 10 ft of another Leechwolf, gains +1 DR and advantage on attack rolls.

abilities.name: Silent Skulk (Passive)
abilities.notes: Gains +2 Stealth in swamp terrain. Cannot be detected by sound while moving unless within 5 ft.

abilities.name: Bloodtrail Focus (Triggered)
abilities.notes: If a creature is bleeding, can track it unerringly for 1 hour, even across rivers or cliffs.

lore: Believed to be the spawn of corrupted wolves that fed too long on carrion. When one bayed at the moon, it was answered by silence — and transformation. A wolf-sized creature with a slick, segmented body covered in ridged black fur and backward-facing thorns. Its face splits into four leech-like flaps, revealing a barbed tongue.

name: Thorned Spider
environment: Forests, caves, ruins, web-choked ravines

attacks.name: Bite (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: one Bite + one Web. Target must make Endurance save (DC 15) or be Poisoned for 1 minute (save ends each turn). Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Web (Rech 5-6, 30/60 ft)
attacks.notes: Target is Restrained by webbing. DC 15 Strength check to escape. Web: AC 10, 10 HP, vulnerable to fire, immune to bludgeoning/poison/psychic.

abilities.name: Thorned Body (Passive)
abilities.notes: Creatures that touch the spider or hit it with a melee attack within 5 ft take 1d10 Piercing damage.

abilities.name: Web Walker (Passive)
abilities.notes: Moves across its own webs and other webs without being hindered by difficult terrain. Tremorsense 30 ft.

lore: A large spider covered in sharp thorns, capable of delivering venomous bites and ensnaring prey with its webs. The thorned spider uses its thorny body as both defense and weapon, making it dangerous in close combat. Its ability to move effortlessly through webs allows it to ambush and trap unsuspecting creatures.

name: Tidewrought Serpent
environment: Coastal cliffs, tidal caves, open sea during storm surge

attacks.name: Tidal Coil (High Tide)
attacks.notes: Grapples a Large or smaller target and crushes at the start of each of its turns (2d6 automatic). Melee 10 ft.

attacks.name: Snapping Surge (Any Form)
attacks.notes: Target must make Endurance save (DC 14) or be pushed 10 ft and knocked prone.

attacks.name: Salt Pulse (Low Tide, Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: Creatures in area take -1 DR for 1 turn from burning saline spray.

abilities.name: Flow-Bound Form (Passive)
abilities.notes: Shifts between Low Tide (Medium, HP 42, DR 2, Swim 50 ft) and High Tide (Huge, HP 88, DR 4, Swim 40 ft) every 2d4 rounds. Lunar or magical interference may lock the form.

abilities.name: Tidecall Instinct (High Tide)
abilities.notes: If injured, can retreat into deep water and recover 2d6 HP if submerged for 1 full round without taking damage.

lore: Local legends treat the Tidewrought as a guardian of sacred tide pools. Some coastal cults leave offerings to keep it docile during full moons. A serpentine sea creature with skin like rolling waves — iridescent blues and stormy grays ripple along its body. Coral-like ridges grow from its spine, and bioluminescent gills flare when agitated.

name: T'rellin Commoner
environment: Giant oak canopy settlements

attacks.name: Chitin Blade
attacks.notes: If two T'rellin commoners attack the same target in a round, the second gains +1 damage. Melee 5 ft.

abilities.name: Canopy Dweller
abilities.notes: Climb speed equal to walking speed. Can glide short distances using thin limb membranes. Nearly silent through trees.

abilities.name: Communal Defense
abilities.notes: Flees and alerts others if attacked. Only defends when cornered. Trained to prioritize colony survival over individual combat.

lore: Commoners of the T'rellin tend the fungus gardens and keep the canopy paths clear. Their deep respect for nature and the Veil Above guides their quiet lives. They see outsiders as dangerous but fascinating. Slender, angular insectoids with pale green or bark-brown chitin, triangular heads, and compound eyes that shimmer faintly.

name: T'rellin Priest-Mother
environment: Crown-vault temples in ancient oaks

attacks.name: Royal Antennae Pulse
attacks.notes: The next attack against the target ignores DR. Ranged 30 ft.

attacks.name: Psychic Web (1/rest)
attacks.notes: Creatures must make Intelligence save (DC 15) or become disoriented (-1 to all checks for 1 round).

attacks.name: Crushing Roots (1/rest)
attacks.notes: Roots erupt dealing 2d4 Bludgeoning. Endurance save (DC 14) halves damage.

abilities.name: Spirit Call (1/rest)
abilities.notes: Summons a spectral insect guardian for 2 rounds. It makes 1d6 Arcane attacks that ignore DR.

abilities.name: Illusory Heat (1/rest)
abilities.notes: Creates comforting light and warmth in a 10 ft radius. Creatures must make Wisdom save (DC 14) or be Charmed for 1 round.

abilities.name: Hive Resonance
abilities.notes: Cannot be deceived through normal means — uses communal memory to detect falsehoods. Every action is deliberate; even silence is a form of pressure.

lore: The Priest-Mother is both monarch and spiritual guide. She knows every name within her colony and every dream her people whisper. Her power is subtle and layered, hidden behind ceremony and insect song. In battle, her words alone can fracture weaker minds. Larger and more ornate than other T'rellin, she wears bands of bark-gold and hanging mosses, her frilled antennae rising like a crown and chitin etched with glyphs that glow under moonlight.

name: T'rellin Shaman
environment: Canopy sanctuaries in high oak groves

attacks.name: Staff of Lichen
attacks.notes: On hit, target's next saving throw is at -1 (fungal spores cling to skin). Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Entangle (1/rest)
attacks.notes: Targets make Nimbleness save (DC 14) or become Restrained for 1 round.

attacks.name: Sporeblind (1/rest)
attacks.notes: Wisdom save (DC 13) or suffer Disadvantage on next attack.

abilities.name: Chitin Shield (1/rest)
abilities.effect: Self or ally gains +1 DR for 2 rounds.

abilities.name: Canopy Seer
abilities.notes: Interprets canopy omens and listens to the breath of the wind. Remains behind warriors, supporting with terrain manipulation and DR buffs.

lore: T'rellin Shamans interpret canopy omens and listen to the breath of the wind. They believe the 'Veil Above' shelters them from skyfire and death. Outsiders who show respect may be offered riddles or strange prophecies. Draped in veils of moss and woven lichen, the shaman bears swirling patterns of spore-dust on its green chitin, its antennae constantly twitching as it listens to the canopy's voice.

name: T'rellin Warrior
environment: Giant oak canopy strongholds

attacks.name: Scythe Slash
attacks.notes: If attacking from above or higher elevation, deal +1d4 damage. On max damage, target must succeed Endurance save (DC 13) or be knocked back 5 ft. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Resin Net (1/rest)
attacks.notes: Target must succeed a Nimbleness save (DC 14) or become Entangled (movement reduced to 5 ft for 1 round).

abilities.name: Canopy Ambusher
abilities.notes: Climb speed equal to walking speed. Remains motionless among leaves and bark until striking (Stealth DC 16 to detect). Uses elevation, ambush, and retreat paths.

abilities.name: Tactical Retreat
abilities.notes: If overwhelmed, retreats to alert the colony. Watchful, suspicious of outsiders, but honorable in combat.

lore: T'rellin warriors act as elite scouts and defenders of their treetop villages. While they avoid conflict with ground-walkers, they are capable of brutal efficiency if provoked or if their colony is threatened. Muscular despite their small size, with widened forelimbs ending in sharp, mantis-like blades. Their chitin is dark green or mottled gray for camouflage.

name: Triceratops
environment: Prehistoric valleys, open plains, druidic preserves

attacks.name: Gore
attacks.notes: Trampling Charge: if moved 20+ ft toward target and hits, Strength save (DC 13) or knocked Prone. Bonus Stomp vs prone target. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Stomp (vs Prone only)
attacks.notes: Bonus action after Trampling Charge. Only vs prone targets.

abilities.name: Trampling Charge (Passive)
abilities.notes: If it moves 20+ ft straight toward a target and hits with Gore, target makes Strength save (DC 13) or is knocked Prone. Can make a bonus Stomp attack against a prone target.

lore: A heavily armored herbivore with three horns and a bone frill, the Triceratops is as dangerous as any predator when threatened. At 50 ft speed it closes fast, and a Trampling Charge into bonus Stomp can deal 7d8+3d10+12 in one turn — potentially over 60 damage to any creature knocked prone.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
environment: Prehistoric valleys, overgrown ruins, druidic preserves

attacks.name: Bite (Multiattack, 10 ft)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: one Bite + one Tail (not same target). Medium or smaller targets are Grappled (DC 17) and Restrained — T-Rex can't bite another while grappling.

attacks.name: Tail (Multiattack, 10 ft)
attacks.notes: Must target a different creature than the Bite. Reach 10 ft.

abilities.name: Apex Predator
abilities.notes: STR 25, 50 ft speed — the fastest Large+ creature in the bestiary. Passive Perception 17 makes ambushing it nearly impossible. A grappled Medium or smaller target is fully Restrained until escape (DC 17 Strength).

lore: The apex of the prehistoric food chain. 50 ft speed means it closes on almost anything in a single move. Its Bite averages 35 piercing damage and locks a Medium or smaller target in its jaws — Restrained and unable to escape without a DC 17 Strength check — while its Tail swats a second target simultaneously.

name: Velociraptor
environment: Prehistoric valleys, jungle ruins, druidic preserves

attacks.name: Bite (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: one Bite + one Claws. Pounce: if moved 20+ ft toward target and hits with Claws, Strength save (DC 12) or knocked Prone; bonus Bite vs prone. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Claws (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Melee 5 ft.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics (Passive)
abilities.notes: Gains advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5 ft of the target and not incapacitated.

lore: A small, feathered pack predator that hunts with terrifying coordination. Individually fragile, a pack of 6-8 raptors with Pack Tactics advantage and Pounce knockdown chains can overwhelm creatures far larger than themselves. 40 ft speed makes them nearly impossible to outrun.

name: Venomous Swarm
environment: Forests, caves, ruins, swamps, anywhere warm

attacks.name: Bites
attacks.notes: Targets in the swarm's space. Sneak Attack: +2d6 Poison if it has advantage or target is unaware. Reach 0 ft (occupies same space as target).

abilities.name: Venomous Sting (Passive)
abilities.notes: Creatures starting their turn in the swarm's space must make Endurance save (DC 13) or take 2d6 Poison, half on success.

abilities.name: Swarm (Passive)
abilities.notes: Can occupy another creature's space and move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. Cannot regain HP or gain temp HP.

lore: A cloud of tiny venomous insects — wasps, hornets, or stinging beetles — that overwhelm prey with countless stings. The swarm occupies the same space as its target, making escape difficult without AoE. Venomous Sting ticks poison every turn for free, making prolonged exposure increasingly dangerous.

name: Vulturis Bone Shaman
environment: Battlefields, wastelands, bone-strewn ruins

attacks.name: Bone Staff (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Multiattack with Rotting Beak. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Rotting Beak (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Target must make Endurance save (DC 15) or become Poisoned for 1 minute (save ends each turn).

attacks.name: Blackened Feather Swarm (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: All creatures take 6d6 Necrotic and must make Strength save (DC 15) or be knocked Prone.

abilities.name: Bone Rites (3 fetishes/rest)
abilities.notes: Expend a bone fetish for: Wail of the Forgotten (20 ft, DC 15 WIS or Frightened), Curse of Withering (30 ft, DC 15 END or disadvantage on STR/DEX), or Raise the Fallen (animate a skeletal vulturis from a corpse).

abilities.name: Tainted Flesh (Passive)
abilities.notes: Melee attackers take 2d6 Necrotic damage from decayed energy stored within its flesh.

lore: The Bone Shaman fights with cruelty and cunning, staying at the edge of battle, weakening foes before sending in its minions. It whispers to the bones it carries, speaking with the dead without components. Their bones whisper secrets; their magic twists the dying into something unnatural.

name: Vulturis Deathlord
environment: Battlefields, carrion wastelands, bone-throne lairs

attacks.name: Beak (Multiattack x3)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: 1 Beak + 2 Talon Swipes. If target is below half HP, Strength save (DC 16) or be knocked Prone.

attacks.name: Talon Swipe (x2, 10 ft)
attacks.notes: Reach 10 ft. Swooping Predator: if moved 20+ ft before attacking, gain advantage and +4d6 damage.

attacks.name: Death Dive (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: If airborne, dives at high speed. Nimbleness save (DC 16) or take full damage and be knocked Prone.

abilities.name: Aura of Dread (10 ft)
abilities.notes: Creatures starting their turn within 10 ft must make Wisdom save (DC 16) or be Frightened until end of next turn. Success = immune for 24 hours.

abilities.name: Unholy Resilience (1/rest)
abilities.notes: First time it would drop to 0 HP, remains at 1 HP and gains 20 temporary HP instead.

abilities.name: Rending Frenzy (Rech 5-6)
abilities.notes: Strikes all creatures within 10 ft. Nimbleness save (DC 16) or take 6d8 Slashing, half on success.

lore: It does not hunt for food. It hunts for sport. The Deathlord is an apex predator that strikes hard and fast, seeking to overwhelm foes with sheer brutality. It swoops in, attacks, then glides away before enemies can counterattack. If the battle turns against it, it Death Dives and flees, waiting for another chance to hunt.

name: Vulturis
environment: Battlefields, wastelands, highland cliffs, ruins

attacks.name: Beak (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Multiattack with Talons. +1d6 Necrotic if target is below half HP (Tear Flesh). Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Talons (Multiattack)
attacks.notes: Target must succeed Strength save (DC 14) or be knocked Prone. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Mark the Dying (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: Up to 3 creatures make Wisdom save (DC 14) or be Frightened for 1 minute and glow faintly, allowing all Vulturis within 60 ft to track them through walls.

abilities.name: Death Sense (Passive, 60 ft)
abilities.notes: Can sense creatures below 10 HP within 60 ft, even through walls. Knows they are weakened but not exact HP.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics (Passive)
abilities.notes: Gains advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5 ft of the target. Feast Upon the Fallen: can consume a corpse to regain 10 HP and gain advantage on next attack.

abilities.name: Carrion Ambusher (Passive)
abilities.notes: If motionless for 1 minute, gains advantage on Stealth. Glides silently — travels 10 ft forward for every 5 ft fallen, taking no fall damage.

lore: Called 'Graveborne' or 'Shadow-Wings' by survivors. Many believe they commune with the dead, speaking with souls before feasting on remains. Some claim they have eldritch patrons whispering secrets of the afterlife. Regardless of origins, one thing is certain: if you see their red eyes gleaming in the darkness, it's already too late.

name: Weeping Cypress
environment: Deep swamps, cursed bogs, old battlefields lost to marsh

attacks.name: Grieving Tendril (20 ft reach)
attacks.notes: If target is Frightened or Charmed, they take an additional 1d6 Psychic damage.

attacks.name: Sap Weep (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: Creatures must succeed Wisdom save (DC 15) or be Charmed and Weeping (incapacitated with sorrow) for 1 round.

attacks.name: Lash of Roots (10 ft line)
attacks.notes: On hit, target is Restrained until end of next turn. Endurance save (DC 14) to end early.

abilities.name: Echoes of Grief (Aura, 10 ft)
abilities.notes: Creatures within 10 ft must make Wisdom save (DC 13) each round or suffer disadvantage on attacks as voices whisper from within the bark.

abilities.name: Stillness of Ages (Passive)
abilities.notes: If motionless for 1 minute, becomes indistinguishable from a non-magical tree. DC 18 Insight or Arcana to detect.

lore: Said to grow only where a soul died in despair. Some believe their roots consume pain. Others say they are prisons for fallen dryads who disobeyed the gods. A towering, ancient cypress with bark twisted into faces mid-scream. Moss drapes from its branches like funeral veils, and from its central trunk, black sap leaks and forms faintly glowing pools.

name: Whippoorwail
environment: Forest edges, grave glades, hillsides near burial grounds

attacks.name: Soul Peck
attacks.notes: If target is below half HP, they must succeed a Luck save (DC 12) or lose 1 additional HP and suffer -1 to Endurance saves for 1 round.

attacks.name: Cry of the Dying (1/rest)
attacks.notes: All living creatures who can hear must make a Wisdom save (DC 13) or become Soul-Shaken (-1 to all checks and saves for 1 minute). Undead and constructs are immune.

abilities.name: Death-Linked
abilities.notes: If a creature within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, the Whippoorwail gains +1 DR for 1 round and may immediately fly up to 15 ft without provoking reactions.

abilities.name: Fade Between (1/day)
abilities.notes: Becomes partially incorporeal until the start of its next turn. Ignores non-magical attacks and terrain.

abilities.name: Omen Beast
abilities.notes: If heard during a long rest, the party does not recover Luck Dice unless the bird is found and driven off.

lore: Considered a death omen across Solryn, the Whippoorwail is said to sing for the dying and feed on the soul's heat. Some believe their presence calls the Reaper. Others say they are the Reaper's pet. Its weak, unstable soul core is destroyed if slain with radiant damage.

name: Willowwitch
environment: Swamps, cursed willow groves, fog-shrouded riverbanks

attacks.name: Grasp of Mourning
attacks.notes: Target must succeed Wisdom save (DC 15) or forget the last action they took (cannot repeat it next round). Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Sorrow's Lullaby (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: All creatures must make Wisdom save (DC 15) or be Charmed and Slowed for 1 round. If already Charmed, they become Unconscious (save ends early if damaged).

attacks.name: Memory Leech (1/rest)
attacks.notes: Drains memories from a single target. Intelligence save (DC 16) or forget one known spell, ability, or name for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Sympathy Feed (Passive)
abilities.notes: Gains +1 DR against any creature that is Charmed or Unconscious nearby.

abilities.name: Hidden in Grief (Passive)
abilities.notes: Cannot be detected by creatures currently under the Frightened, Charmed, or Sorrowed condition.

lore: Willowwitches are believed to form when a dryad dies from heartbreak. They remember every name ever whispered beneath their trees — and resent those who forget the dead. A willowy, feminine figure with bark-textured skin and moss for hair, her limbs ending in twisted roots. Glowing tears stream constantly down her wooden cheeks.

name: Wood Golem
environment: Druidic groves, enchanted forests, ancient nature shrines

attacks.name: Slam (x2)
attacks.notes: Multiattack: two Slam attacks. Melee 5 ft.

attacks.name: Entangling Roots (Rech 5-6)
attacks.notes: Roots erupt in 20 ft radius. Area = difficult terrain for 1 min. Chosen creatures make Strength save (DC 15) or be Restrained. DC 15 Strength check (action) to escape.

abilities.name: Fire Vulnerability & Magic Resistance
abilities.notes: Vulnerable to Fire damage — the obvious counter. Magic Resistance gives advantage on spell saves. Resistant to nonmagical piercing and slashing. Immune to poison and psychic.

lore: A towering guardian of living and carved wood, animated by druidic rites. Its Entangling Roots can lock down an entire party in a 20 ft radius, turning the battlefield into a killing ground for allied creatures. Fire is the obvious answer, but Magic Resistance means even fire spells require good rolls. Easy to counter in open terrain; devastating in a dense forest.
